name: studio-bridge
description: Lets Claude desktop talk to the Marketing Studio Service running on this laptop. Loopback only.
long_description: Forwards MCP over stdio to http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp with your Studio token. It opens no port, adds no tools and decides nothing: the Studio Service checks the token and owns every tool. Approvals still happen in the Studio Inbox on this laptop.

token.title: Studio token
token.description: The output of: cat ~/.studio-service/tenants/*/token. Stored by Claude desktop, sent only to 127.0.0.1.

port.title: Studio Service port
port.description: The port the Studio Service listens on at 127.0.0.1.
